name: WHO WANTS TO BE THE EMPEROR?
source:
In the midst of a world-changing political conference, a hapless guard and would-be assassin dispose of a politician's corpse.  

[From [url=https://gertritude.itch.io/who-wants-to-be-the-emperor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一场足以改变世界格局的政治会议期间，一名倒霉的卫兵与一名准刺客联手处理一具政客的尸体。

[摘自[url=https://gertritude.itch.io/who-wants-to-be-the-emperor]itch.io[/url]]
